role: Database Reliability Engineer/Database Engineer (Rubrik Security Cloud Platform)
description: <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle.</span></p> <h3><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">What you'll do</span></strong></h3> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Performance &amp; Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Disaster Recovery &amp; Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Storage Optimization &amp; Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Transactional Reliability &amp; Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Infrastructure as Code &amp; Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana)</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience you'll need</span></strong></h3> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Database Internals &amp; RDBMS Fundamentals:</span> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats).</span></li> </ul> </li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Operational Database Experience:</span> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL].</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ</span></li> </ul> </li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Systems &amp; Kernel Engineering:</span> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Strong Linux fundamentals: I/O subsystems, page cache vs. engine buffer pools, disk alignment, asynchronous I/O, and memory management.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Automation &amp; Software Engineering:</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Using&nbsp; Python or Go for building database automation, operators, and CLI tooling.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration.</span></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Preferred skills and qualifications</span></h3> <ul> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on administration and performance tuning of ClickHouse (cluster topologies, ZooKeeper/Keeper coordination, MergeTree engine family, mutations, and compaction).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience with change data capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, Kafka) feeding transactional updates into ClickHouse/Iceberg.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience managing lakehouse storage patterns using Apache Iceberg (metadata management, snapshot expiration, file compaction/orphan cleanup).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience with automated schema migration tools (e.g., gh-ost, Liquibase, Bytebase).</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Familiarity with distributed consensus engines ( ClickHouse Keeper,Raft, Paxos).</span></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;
